cues: With hydroxide, the equilibrium constant is K a over K w, ten thousand: the reaction goes to completion, and phenol dissolves.
With bicarbonate, it is K a of phenol over K a of carbonic acid, two point two times ten to the minus four: almost no reaction, so no carbonic acid, and no carbon dioxide.
Phenol is weaker than carbonic acid.
